read: The board leans risk-off: BTC, ETH, SOL and most alts sit in 1d breakdowns, and the largest local imbalance is XPL with funding 48.39 and OI 24h +34.8%. Base case, five open setups leave no room for new ones.

watchlist.note: Funding 48.39 ann % with OI 24h +34.8% and a 4h sweep of the high; 1d rangePos 0.44 keeps funding_fade 0.36 short of its trigger. We lean toward a fade if price loses the 4h range.
watchlist.arms: 1d rangePos at or above 0.8 with funding staying above 30 and a level in the menu at least 2R away

watchlist.note: OI 24h -14.84% with price 2.02 1d ATR down and funding at 10.95; 4h vsSma20Atr -2.9. Washout reads as a reclaim candidate, low-confidence until a close back above the 4h low20.
watchlist.arms: a 4h close back above the 4h low20 with funding still at or under 10.95 and a level in the menu at least 2R away

watchlist.note: Reclaim tripwire hit: OI 24h -8.29% with funding -9.35 after a 1d breakdown on volRatio 2.74. Risk skews to a bounce if funding stays reset, but the 1d trend is down.
watchlist.arms: a 4h close back above the 1d low20 with funding still under 10.95 and a level in the menu at least 2R away

watchlist.note: Funding -12.17 ann % with OI 24h -10.52%; the 24h move is -1.11 ATR against the -1.5 washout threshold (gap 0.26). 1d rangePos 0.05.
watchlist.arms: 24h move at or below -1.5 1d ATR with OI 24h at or below -8% and a level in the menu at least 2R away

watchlist.note: 24h move -2.57 1d ATR (met) but OI 24h -4.88% against -8 (not met); 1d breakout down with volRatio 2.14, mark below the STH cost basis only if a daily close confirms.
watchlist.arms: OI 24h at or below -8% with funding at or under 10.95 and a level in the menu at least 2R away

watchlist.note: 1d breakout down with volRatio 1.28 against 1.3 needed (gap 0.02) and funding 2.56 ann %; 1d rangePos 0.1.
watchlist.arms: 1d volume ratio at or above 1.3 on the breakdown with OI 24h staying positive and a level in the menu at least 2R away

brief: No new setups: five of five slots are open (AAVE, kPEPE, UNI, XMR, LINK paths). Fourteen tripwire hits, mostly 1d breakdown shorts and reclaim longs, all passed on slots. Largest imbalance is XPL, funding 48.39 ann % with OI 24h +34.8%; we lean toward a fade only once 1d rangePos reaches 0.8. hl-cycles is stale (13.4 h), regime mild risk-off. Risk skews to a bounce on reclaim names (CRV, ETH) if funding stays reset; a 4h reclaim close would prove the read, a fresh low would break it.
